name: ESP32-C3 MicroPython GPS Navigator (GT-U7 & ST7735R)
description: Comprehensive engineering suite & real-time 1.8" TFT simulator for ESP32-C3 SuperMini + GT-U7 GPS + ST7735R display. Includes full MicroPython firmware (Codes, Docs, HMI, md, History), live multi-window navigation HMI, breadcrumb map, NMEA stream engine, and project ZIP exporter.
